name: demo-script
description: Prepare a reproducible 60-second VenturaGenArt demo that proves one implemented visual workflow with model and hardware assumptions visible. Use when an executable MVP slice needs a concise demonstration. Do not use when the pipeline is unimplemented or depends on undocumented local state.

# Demo script

- Use one versioned prompt or reference input and one documented model path.
- Show the generation or editing command and resulting artifact location.
- State seed model hardware and key parameters required for reproduction.
- Include one known limitation such as runtime memory or consistency.
- Avoid broad quality claims from a single sample.
- Verify the workflow from a clean checkout before publishing.
